Local dispatch filters committed checkpoints by:

- The default seven-day window.
- Checkpoint branch metadata.
- Checkpoint trailers reachable from the selected branch.

The critical filter is [mode_local.go](/Users/peytonmontei/Documents/entire/devenv/entireio/cli/.worktrees/dispatch/cmd/entire/cli/dispatch/mode_local.go:190). On a feature branch it deliberately searches only `<default-branch>..HEAD`.

- Webhook/branch synchronization missed the commits.
- Checkpoint payloads were ingested, but the commit-link junction rows were never created.

+# Local Dispatch Agent Selection
+
+## Status
+
+Approved design for adding `--agent` to `entire dispatch`.
+
+## Problem
+
+`entire dispatch --local` currently hard-codes Claude Code as its text
+generator. This makes local dispatch depend on Claude's installation and
+credentials even when the user has configured another summary-capable agent.
+It also conflicts with the command's user-facing description, which refers to
+the locally installed agent CLI without saying that only Claude is supported.
+
+Cloud dispatch has a different execution model. The CLI sends repository,
+window, and voice inputs to Entire's service, and the service chooses and runs
+the server-side generator. A local CLI agent name has no meaning in that flow.
+
+## Goals
+
+- Add a one-run `--agent <name>` override for local dispatch generation.
+- Reject `--agent` unless `--local` is also set.
+- When `--agent` is absent, use the same configured summary-provider selection
+  used by `entire checkpoint explain --generate`.
+- Support every installed agent that implements `agent.TextGenerator`,
+  including eligible external `entire-agent-*` plugins.
+- Keep cloud dispatch behavior and its HTTP request contract unchanged.
+- Do not mutate saved provider settings when `--agent` is explicitly supplied.
+
+## Non-goals
+
+- Selecting the server-side cloud dispatch model or provider.
+- Adding a `--model` override.
+- Changing checkpoint enumeration, branch filtering, time-window filtering, or
+  empty-activity behavior.
+- Changing agent authentication flows.
+- Adding an agent picker inside the dispatch wizard. Local wizard runs without
+  an override will use the normal summary-provider resolver, which may perform
+  its existing selection flow when no provider has been saved.
+
+## CLI Contract
+
+Valid examples:
+
+```console
+entire dispatch --local --agent codex
+entire dispatch --local --agent claude-code --since 14d
+entire dispatch --local
+```
+
+Invalid example:
+
+```console
+$ entire dispatch --agent codex
+Error: --agent only applies to --local (cloud dispatch uses Entire's server-side generator)
+```
+
+The flag accepts registered agent names, matching the provider names used by
+`summary_generation.provider` and the agent registry. The selected agent must
+implement `agent.TextGenerator`, and its CLI must be available on `PATH`.
+
+Selection precedence for local mode is:
+
+1. Explicit `--agent` override for this invocation.
+2. Saved `summary_generation.provider` and optional configured model.
+3. The existing summary-provider discovery and selection behavior.
+
+An explicit override does not update `settings.local.json`, change
+`summary_generation.provider`, or enable external agents persistently. Naming
+an external text-generator plugin explicitly is sufficient one-run consent to
+discover and use that plugin for the current process.
+
+## Architecture
+
+Provider resolution remains in the `cmd/entire/cli` layer, where settings,
+interactive selection, external-agent discovery, and user-facing output already
+live. The `cmd/entire/cli/dispatch` package remains responsible for checkpoint
+collection, prompt construction, and text generation, but no longer chooses a
+provider itself.
+
+The CLI layer will:
+
+1. Parse and validate `--agent` together with the existing dispatch flags.
+2. Skip all local-provider resolution for cloud mode.
+3. Resolve an explicit override without persisting it, or call the existing
+   summary-provider resolver when no override is present.
+4. Pass the resolved `agent.TextGenerator` and effective model into local
+   dispatch execution.
+
+The dispatch package will:
+
+1. Accept an injected text generator and model in its local execution options.
+2. Use them in `generateLocalDispatch`.
+3. Return a clear internal-contract error if local execution somehow reaches
+   generation without a resolved generator.
+
+This direction avoids importing the parent `cli` package from `dispatch`, keeps
+interactive and persistence concerns out of the lower-level package, and makes
+local generation straightforward to test with a stub generator.
+
+## Provider Resolution
+
+The existing summary-provider code should be reused rather than duplicated.
+It already handles:
+
+- Built-in and external agent discovery.
+- `agent.TextGenerator` capability checks.
+- CLI availability checks.
+- Configured models and provider-default models.
+- Interactive and non-interactive default selection.
+- Persistence of an automatically selected default.
+
+A small explicit-override path should share the same discovery, validation, and
+provider-building helpers but deliberately skip `persistSummaryProviderSelection`.
+The provider result should expose the raw `agent.TextGenerator` alongside its
+effective model so dispatch can consume it without adapting through the
+checkpoint-summary `summarize.Generator` interface.
+
+## Data Flow
+
+```text
+dispatch flags
+    |
+    +-- cloud mode -----------------> existing server request
+    |
+    `-- local mode
+          |
+          +-- --agent set ----------> resolve one-run provider
+          |
+          `-- no --agent -----------> resolve saved/default provider
+                                        |
+                                        v
+                              TextGenerator + model
+                                        |
+                                        v
+                         enumerate local checkpoints
+                                        |
+                                        v
+                           build dispatch prompt
+                                        |
+                                        v
+                           provider.GenerateText
+```
+
+Checkpoint enumeration remains provider-independent. Provider resolution may
+happen before enumeration so invalid agent requests fail quickly and
+consistently; no generation is attempted until enumeration and prompt building
+succeed.
+
+## Errors and User Guidance
+
+- `--agent` without `--local`: reject during option validation before auth or
+  network work.
+- Unknown agent: name the invalid value and retain the agent registry's useful
+  cause.
+- Agent lacks text-generation capability: report that the agent does not
+  support local dispatch generation.
+- Agent CLI missing from `PATH`: report the missing local dependency and invite
+  the user to choose another provider.
+- Provider authentication/configuration errors: preserve typed provider errors
+  and their safe message.
+- No installed provider with no explicit override: retain the existing summary
+  provider discovery error.
+
+Cloud mode must not inspect local provider settings or local CLI availability.
+
+## Help and Discoverability
+
+The flag help should make its scope explicit:
+
+```text
+--agent string   local text-generation agent (requires --local)
+```
+
+The dispatch long help should include one local override example. Because
+`agent-help` renders the Cobra tree, registering the flag on the dispatch
+command automatically exposes it to agents.
+
+## Testing
+
+Add focused tests for:
+
+- Parsing `--local --agent codex` into local options.
+- Rejecting `--agent` in cloud mode.
+- Ensuring cloud rejection occurs before auth/network work.
+- Resolving an explicit built-in provider and forwarding its generator/model.
+- Resolving an explicit external text-generator plugin for one invocation.
+- Confirming an explicit override does not write provider settings.
+- Using the configured summary provider and configured model when the flag is
+  absent.
+- Preserving existing default provider selection when neither flag nor setting
+  exists.
+- Rejecting unknown, unavailable, and non-text-generator agents.
+- Verifying local dispatch invokes the injected generator instead of the
+  hard-coded Claude factory.
+- Verifying cloud dispatch never resolves or invokes a local provider.
+- Updating help/option tests to cover the new flag and example.
+
+Tests should use `t.Parallel()` unless they replace package-level seams or
+modify process-global environment, in accordance with repository policy.
+
+## Compatibility
+
+Cloud dispatch is unchanged. Local dispatch without `--agent` changes from an
+implicit Claude dependency to the established summary-provider selection. A
+machine that already has `summary_generation.provider: claude-code` retains
+Claude behavior; users configured for Codex, Gemini, or another capable agent
+gain consistent behavior across explain summaries and local dispatches.
+
+No settings migration is required.
*** End Patch";
